description:
Listen & Download 'Janam Janam': https://SMI.lnk.to/JanamJanam


Sing along Janam Janam with Shah Rukh Khan and Kajol, and live the romance! This romantic chartbuster from Dilwale is composed by Pritam, written by Amitabh Bhattacharya and sung by Arijit Singh & Antara Mitra. Some songs are just meant for the love stories which never end!

👉 Subscribe To Sony Music India - http://bit.ly/SonyMusic_YouTube
 
Listen on Apple Music & Download on iTunes.
 
Dilwale releases in Cinemas on the 18th of December.
